text:
Yes, there are two kinds of back-seat screens for the Model Y. Which one to buy depends on your model year.

**1. Rear-seat touchscreen (2019-2024 Model Y)**
These are 8.66" Android displays that mount behind the center console. They stream video and can control rear AC and seat heating.
- **Tesery 8.66" Android Rear Display:** $359 (regular $409), with a 4.7-star rating from 22 reviews on Tesery's own site. It fits Model Y 2020 to 2025.03, and Tesery offers 30-day returns. [Buy here](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla)
- **Amazon 8.66" options:** These run about $304 to $330. The $329.99 Android 13 model (4GB+64GB) has 3.9 stars from 41 reviews. The $303.99 model has 3.6 stars from only 10 reviews. They're listed for Model Y 2019 to 2024. [See Amazon listings](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen)
- **Aear 8.8" at SquareWheels:** $299, but it's currently sold out. [Page](https://squarewheelsauto.com/products/rear-entertainment-screen-for-tesla-model-y)

**2. Projector screen (2025-2026 "Juniper" Model Y)**
I didn't find a rear display in these results that's listed for the 2025+ refresh. The Tesery one stops at 2025.03, and the Amazon ones stop at 2024. The Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema is made for the refresh. It's a clip-in screen and sunshade for the rear window or roof that works as a 47-50" projection surface.
- Price is $119.99 with free shipping, a 1-year warranty and a 30-day return window. [Buy at Aurzen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y)
- It has no screen of its own, so you need a separate portable projector, which isn't included.
- It's for use while parked only.
- It fits 2020-2024 cars only in roof mode, because the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window.
- A third-party deal site, Dealectric, reports that code CJ10 took $11.99 off in testing. [That page](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y) is an affiliate link, and its own terms say the code may not combine with sale prices. Checkout has the final word.

**My recommendation**
- **2020-2024 Model Y, kids or passengers watching while you drive:** the Tesery at $359 has the best-looking reviews and a clear return policy. If you want to spend less, the $329.99 Amazon model has the most reviews of the Amazon options.
- **2025-2026 Model Y:** the Aurzen screen is the only one here confirmed to fit. It's really a parked-movie setup, not a screen for use while driving.

Before buying, confirm your exact model year and that the seller lists it as compatible. Prices and stock change, so check them at checkout. If you tell me your model year and whether the screen is for driving or for parked movies, I can narrow this to one pick.
